anchors.title: Surfers Paradise Beach
anchors.description: Three kilometres of golden sand backed by the Gold Coast's neon high-rise skyline. Surf lifesaving patrols, daily surf-school lessons and easy parking at Cavill Avenue.

anchors.title: SkyPoint Observation Deck
anchors.description: 230 metres up the Q1 Tower — Australia's tallest residential building — for 360° views from the hinterland to the Pacific. Optional 'SkyPoint Climb' on the spire takes you 100m higher.

anchors.title: Currumbin Wildlife Sanctuary
anchors.description: 27 hectares of bushland-set Australian wildlife. Hand-feed wild rainbow lorikeets at the daily lorikeet feeding (since 1947), and meet koalas, kangaroos and the resident free-flight birds.

anchors.title: Burleigh Heads National Park
anchors.description: Sub-tropical rainforest meets headland in this small national park between Burleigh Beach and Tallebudgera Creek. The 2.3km Oceanview Track passes some of the Gold Coast's best surf breaks.

anchors.title: Tamborine Mountain Day Trip
anchors.description: 45 minutes inland to the Gold Coast hinterland — Gallery Walk artisan strip, the Tamborine Rainforest Skywalk, distilleries, and the Curtis Falls walk through subtropical rainforest.

WEDNESDAY.title: Surfers Paradise Beachfront Markets
WEDNESDAY.description: Saltwater-air market under the palms along the esplanade. 100+ stalls of beachy fashion, jewellery and crafts every Wednesday, Friday and Sunday from 4pm-9pm.

FRIDAY.title: Surfers Paradise Beachfront Markets
FRIDAY.description: The Friday-night session of the Esplanade market — live buskers and a string of food trucks along Cavill Mall.

SUNDAY.title: The Village Markets — Burleigh Heads
SUNDAY.description: Gold Coast's premier curated handmade market in the grounds of Burleigh State School. Second and fourth Sundays of each month, 8am-1pm.
